description: zapret-discord-youtube (Flowseal): ready-made zapret strategies for Discord, YouTube and other blocked sites (general*.bat), domain and IP lists, and a service manager that installs a strategy as a Windows service and tests them all. winws.exe, cygwin1.dll and WinDivert come from their gesu packages.
notes: Global install only, from an elevated (admin) shell: scoop install -g gesu/zapret-discord-youtube
Scoop Apps: 'zapret-discord-youtube' opens Flowseal's service manager. Find a working strategy with
12. Run Tests, then make it start with Windows: 1. Install Service. First turn on secure DNS (DoH) in the
browser or in Windows 11, as upstream's README says.
The command zapret-discord-youtube does the same, plus: status, stop, start, update, sync, bundled on|off, folder.
Updating: Scoop refuses while winws.exe runs from this package (the service too). 'zapret-discord-youtube
update' stops it, updates this package and its components, and starts the service again.
The service manager's own update check is off (it would download a zip): Scoop updates the package.
winws.exe comes from gesu/zapret (newer than the one Flowseal tested the strategies with), cygwin1.dll from
gesu/Cygwin-Runtime, WinDivert from gesu/WinDivert or, if installed, gesu/WinDivert-hide. Flowseal's own pair
is kept in 'bundled': 'zapret-discord-youtube bundled on' switches winws.exe and cygwin1.dll to it.
Kept across updates in %ProgramData%\scoop\persist\zapret-discord-youtube: your lists (lists\*-user.txt),
the Game Filter setting and the test results. Not kept: the IPSet Filter mode, 'Update IPSet List' and
'Replace active fakes' (they change files that come with each release); set them again after an update.
Edit the *-user.txt lists with an editor that saves in place (Notepad does); one that replaces the file
breaks the link to the persist folder.
Antivirus programs often flag WinDivert as a risk tool; see the package page if yours quarantines it.
pre_install: if (!$global) { error "$app puts a driver or a service on the system, which runs as SYSTEM: install it globally, so that only administrators can change its files: scoop install -g gesu/$app"; break }

if ([System.Runtime.InteropServices.RuntimeInformation]::OSArchitecture -eq 'Arm64') { error "$app has no ARM64 build: the WinDivert driver is x64 only (ARM64 Windows would need test signing)."; break }
# A 'zapret' service from another copy (Flowseal's zip unpacked elsewhere) would fight this one over the
# traffic, and this copy's service manager would replace it. Updates keep their own service.

error "A 'zapret' service from another copy is installed: $($imagePath -replace [regex]::Escape($env:USERPROFILE), '%USERPROFILE%')`nRemove it with that copy's service.bat (2. Remove Services), or set `$env:GESU_ALLOW_EXISTING = '1' and install again; this copy's 'Install Service' then replaces it.`nScoop has already put $app into its app folder: run 'scoop uninstall $app' or simply install again, which cleans that up."
# Flowseal's winws.exe and cygwin1.dll stay in 'bundled' ('zapret-discord-youtube bundled on');
# post_install puts the packages' files into bin. WinDivert in the release is upstream's 2.2.2, the same as gesu/WinDivert.
# Scoop updates the package; the service manager's update check would only open the download page.
# Files the service manager creates on first use, with its own defaults: persisted, so they must exist
# (Scoop would make folders of them). game_filter.enabled with mode=disabled means the filter is off.
# The zapret-discord-youtube command, its shortcut and the component copier (see the package page).
if ($missing) { error "$(Split-Path -Leaf $missing[0]) is missing from the bucket: install with 'scoop install -g gesu/zapret-discord-youtube'."; break }
post_install: # winws.exe, cygwin1.dll and WinDivert into bin from their packages (scripts/zapret/Sync-ZapretComponents.ps1).
pre_uninstall: # 'scoop uninstall' removes this copy's 'zapret' service and WinDivert driver services first (Scoop runs
# this before its own check for running programs). On update Scoop has already refused if winws runs.
if (!(Test-Path "$dir\ZapretDiscordYoutube.ps1")) { warn "ZapretDiscordYoutube.ps1 is missing; remove the 'zapret' service with service.bat first if it is installed."; return }
